symbol: inverted room and bridge field config
evidence: World generator exposes inverted-cone room, noisy top, bridge radius, and small-rock scalar controls as first-class tuning parameters.
Density composes room mass, bridge mass, and small-rock mass into one scalar field before chunk meshing.
Room centers are connected through MST plus a small number of extra graph edges before chunk generation.
Chunk builder samples the shared scalar field and converts it to visible mesh plus trimesh collision asynchronously.
Procedural body orientation, ground locomotion, and glide transitions live in the player controller and should not be imported into Infinite Brutality mass work.
Foot IK root is a simple yaw-follow helper and is explicitly out of scope for the Infinite Brutality mass extraction.
Expedition starts from a semantic room and connector graph with labels, kinds, pattern ids, and anchor payloads before field carving.
Connectors become bounded path segments with per-connector radii and axis metadata, not just abstract graph links.
Field builder emits both the visible asteroid shell and collision triangles from one pass, then attaches dressing afterward.
Scalar field is sampled over a bounded shell volume derived from layout extents, keeping the cave generation spatially disciplined.
Final field sample is the max of shell constraint and the minimum of room and connector carves, preserving outer mass truth while opening interior void.
Rooms are carved as ellipsoid chambers with aperture lobes and layered noise, providing a better template than box-room subtraction.
Tunnels are carved as radius-controlled tubes along authored segments, with end caps and noise perturbation to keep routes readable but organic.
Generator composes layout, field, nav volumes, hazards, pickups, enemies, and dressing into one layer output, showing the right ownership boundary for a future Infinite Brutality mass generator.
